issues.issue: The same line appears as a receipt (category other) in receipts[] and as section 'other financing' in detail (detail entry for Schedule D 5200). The rules ask for the same treatment everywhere in a report. The General Fund shows no matching outflow, and decision_needed already asks about it.

Every Schedule M 'Other Items' line (state object 800) is mapped to dues, training and travel. Object 800 also covers miscellaneous items, so this mapping is a judgment call. The 'Other Property Services' -> professional/contract services mapping is likewise a judgment call.
